subject: Consolidated security-exhibit playbook, audit scope, and cost impacts
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@aureliahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aureliahealth.com; security@aureliahealth.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit — SOC 2 assertions, pen-test window, and evidence cadence

Markus / team,

Thanks for the MSA + order form draft. A few items came up from our InfoSec and procurement groups that we need to lock before legal will sign:

- SOC 2: we need confirmation of the specific Trust Services Criteria covered and whether Redwood will allow an annual report upload to our shared repo.
- Pen test language: Aurelia requires either access for our third-party pentesters (with agreed windows) or a vendor-supplied penetration test report no older than 12 months. We prefer limited staging access vs production access — can you confirm options?
- Audit rights & inspection: request clarification on scope (multi-tenant carveouts, retention of logs, and redaction). We need an evidence cadence proposal so our security team can schedule artifact reviews.
- Cost/ops: there will be costs for dedicated staging time and support during a live pentest; please outline any pass-through or milestone fees so procurement can include in the PO.

Can you propose consolidated language and a recommended cadence (monthly/quarterly/annual evidence runs) that balances their audit needs and your operational model? Would like to get to T&Cs redline by next week.

Elena Morales
Head of Security Operations
Aurelia Health
[Attachment: Aurelia_questions.pdf (pdf)]

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com; laura.bennett@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 assertions, pen-test window, and evidence cadence

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Legal (Priyom), Security Ops (Laura), and Sales Engineering (Ben) to consolidate.

High level from our side:
- SOC 2: Redwood holds a Type II SOC 2 report covering Security and Confidentiality (we can provide the latest report and grant a read-only upload into a shared workspace for your authorized reviewers).
- Pen test: we prefer a staged pentest model (staging environment + scheduled window). Production access is allowed only under strict guardrails; our preference and lower cost is staging.
- Audit scope: default carveout is that customer inspections do not access multi-tenant production data; we can offer scoped inspection and sampling for tenant-specific artifacts.
- Evidence cadence: suggest a two-track cadence — quarterly artifact snapshot (automated extracts / dashboards) plus an annual deep evidence review aligned with SOC reporting. For active pentests we propose a short evidence sprint (2 weeks) with a named ops contact.

Action items:
1) Priyom to propose redline text for MSA/Order Form (audit rights + pen test clause + staging carveouts).
2) Laura to propose an evidence cadence workbook and a short SLA addendum for pentest windows (hours of support, cost bands).
3) Ben will cost out estimated staging hours and support pass-throughs for procurement.

We'll produce a consolidated "playbook" (redline + cadence workbook + cost estimate) by EOD Monday so you can circulate to Aurelia legal/procurement. Attaching a first-pass template.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_playbook_draft.docx (docx)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — proposed redline snippets and options

Team — drafted options below; short notes inline to help Aurelia pick a path. I recommend we present Option B as the default to balance control and operational burden.

---- DRAFT SNIPPETS (for inclusion in Security Exhibit / MSA appendix) ----
Option A — Full inspection right (more permissive)
"Customer may inspect Redwood's relevant systems and records, including access to logs and personnel interviews, subject to a mutually agreed schedule and reasonable security controls. Inspections that require access to Redwood's multi-tenant production systems will be permitted only with prior written consent and a minimum 30-day notice. Customer must reimburse Redwood for any incremental costs incurred to facilitate such inspections (reasonable third-party fees and dedicated engineer time)."

Option B — Scoped inspection + staging pentest (recommended)
"Customer is entitled to scoped inspection and evidence review limited to Customer-specific artifacts and tenant-specific logs. For security testing, Customer may conduct penetration testing against Redwood's designated staging environment during a mutually agreed window. Redwood will provide a named technical liaison and limited support. For access to production systems or tests involving system-wide controls, Customer shall seek prior written consent and reimburse Redwood for costs associated with provisioning and monitoring. Pentest vendors must sign Redwood's NDAs and follow our pentest engagement playbook."

Option C — Vendor-supplied test report (lower friction)
"Customer acknowledges that Redwood may, at its discretion, provide a vendor-supplied penetration test report covering the relevant scope in lieu of direct testing access. Reports will be no older than 12 months. If Customer requires on-site testing or additional controls not covered in the report, Customer must coordinate with Redwood's security team and cover associated costs."

Notes:
- Evidence cadence: propose quarterly automated artifact snapshots (retention window: 90 days accessible, archive stored per agreement) + annual evidence package aligned with SOC 2 Type II periods.
- Costing: include a simple fee schedule in the order form for staging access (blocks of hours) and a rate card for named engineer support during a pentest window.

Attaching redline and a basic evidence cadence workbook for cost estimates. Priyom

[Attachment: pen_test_scope_summary.md (md)]
[Attachment: evidence_cadence_proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com; laura.bennett@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com; procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 assertions, pen-test window, and evidence cadence

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a consolidated package: redline snippets (Option B highlighted), an evidence cadence workbook that maps artifacts to a quarterly/annual cadence, and a short pen-test scope summary. Highlights below so procurement/legal can speed review:

- Recommended path: Option B (Scoped inspection + staged pentest). This minimizes production risk and aligns with our operational model.
- SOC 2: we'll provide the latest Type II covering Security & Confidentiality and grant read-only access for your reviewers to upload to the shared repo.
- Pentest logistics: staging environment will be scheduled in 2-week windows; standard support band covers 8hrs engineer time per window. Additional hours billable per the rate card in the workbook. Vendors must execute our NDA and follow our pentest playbook (we can share the playbook as part of the vendor onboarding).
- Cost impact: typical one-off staging provisioning + monitoring ranges $3k–$7k depending on scope; named engineer support is $250/hr after the included band. Ben included a ballpark estimate in the workbook.
- Evidence cadence: quarterly automated snapshots (low lift) plus an annual deep evidence package timed to SOC reporting. For customers that want monthly visibility we can enable dashboards (additional ingestion fee applies).

Next steps I propose:
1) Aurelia to confirm Option B (scoped + staging) or request Option C (vendor report).
2) Aurelia security to share preferred pentest vendor and NDA contact; vendor to sign Redwood NDA prior to scheduling.
3) Procurement to confirm acceptance of the staging fee band or request a PO amendment to cover estimated costs.

If this works, we'll send a marked MSA/Order Form redline (MSA appendix + order-form fee line item) for your counsel to review tomorrow morning.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(555) 555-0198
